nodes.label: Scoring Formulas F1-F9
nodes.rationale: Pure Python scoring with no LLM calls: F1 normalise, F2 weighted sum, F3 baseline score, F4 uncertainty mapping, F5 aggregate uncertainty, F6 penalised score, F7 confidence interval, F8 non-compensatory gate, F9 deferral rule. Design intent: deterministic, auditable scoring separated from LLM stages.

nodes.label: Self-Consistency (Parallel Runs)
nodes.rationale: Stages 2-6 run 3x in parallel to improve reliability via self-consistency. SELF_CONSISTENCY_RUNS env var controls the number of runs. Trade-off: higher cost but more robust scoring.
